Name: Easy Warps
Author: hinagiku1306
Description:
[size=3][b]Key Features[/b][/size]

Text signs can be used as warp points across the valley. Interacting with the sign to open a menu for warping.

Once you view the cutscene with the Wizard about the community center, he will send a letter the following day. Read it to start using this feature.
Alternatively, this requirement can be disabled in the mod configuration.

[u]How to use[/u]
- When opening any text sign, choose "Use as warp point" to register it. The text can be left blank; location name will be used instead.
- After registering, interact with it again to open the warp menu.
- Click on any row to teleport to that warp point.


[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b]

[/size]Stardew Valley 1.6+
GMCM
[size=3]

[b]Installation[/b]

[/size]1. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
2. Run game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
